name: speccode
description: Multi-requirement parallel development, in-repo spec hosting, standardized PR flow, and SDD methodology (explore / document / plan / subagent execution / review) — a process orchestration plugin.
skillInstructions:
Speccode tool mapping for Kimi Code:
- When a speccode skill says to ask the user (one question at a time, presenting concrete options), call Kimi Code's `AskUserQuestion` tool. Fall back to plain assistant text only if `AskUserQuestion` is unavailable or the session is in an auto permission mode.
- When a speccode skill says to dispatch a subagent (implementer / reviewer / explorer), use Kimi Code's `Agent` tool. Speccode skills that depend on subagents declare a fallback route for hosts without subagents — follow it when the Agent tool is unavailable.
- Speccode engine calls are written as `speccode <verb> --cwd .`. Ensure the engine shim is on PATH first: run `bash scripts/install-shim.sh` from the plugin root once. If the shim is missing, call `node <plugin-root>/bin/speccode.mjs <verb> --cwd .` instead (plugin root = the directory containing this manifest).
- Use Kimi Code's `Read`, `Write`, `Edit`, `Bash`, `Grep`, `Glob`, and web tools by their actual exposed names.
- For in-plugin reference files, resolve the plugin root via `speccode plugin-root --cwd .` rather than hardcoding paths.
